settings.title: What the Fee Does Not Cover

settings.editor:
A nil T2 does not cover your Ontario annual return through the Ontario Business Registry. We tell you if you still owe one.

A federal Corporations Canada annual return costs $12.00 and is due within 60 days of your anniversary. It is a government fee and HST does not apply to it.

This service is for a corporation with no activity in the tax year. A corporation with investment income, rental income, or dividends paid or received is not nil. If your corporation is not nil, we move your file to gondaliyacpa.ca at $350.00 plus applicable sales tax per year and tell you before any further charge.
